items.title: Live: Trump says NATO 'ought to help' in strait; Dubai temporarily suspends flights after drone attack
items.description: US President Donald Trump says the alliance's members are "beneficiaries" of the strait and should "help to make sure that nothing bad happens there".

items.title: Fuel panic buying 'causing system to break down', experts warn
items.description: Experts say Australians should prepare for the possibility of widespread fuel rationing if the war in the Middle East is prolonged.

items.title: Fifth member of Iranian women's soccer team leaves Australia
items.description: A fifth member of the Iranian women's football team withdrew her asylum claim and left the country overnight, the federal government says.

items.title: The US has a convicted felon in the White House. Could SA have one in parliament?
items.description: One-time Liberal opposition leader David Speirs is attempting a political comeback, but even he concedes it's a long shot after a very public downfall where he was convicted of supplying cocaine just over 10 months ago.

items.title: Kyle and Jackie O network slapped with new broadcasting rules after breaches
items.description: The media watchdog imposes new broadcasting rules on KIIS FM owner ARN Media, in response to repeated breaches by controversial radio show The Kyle & Jackie O Show.

items.title: Live: Rose Byrne and Jacob Elordi miss out, Michael B Jordan wins Best Actor
items.description: Australians Rose Byrne and Jacob Elordi will be hoping to cap off their awards season success with the ultimate prizes as the 98th Academy Awards get underway. Follow live.

items.title: Dale swam near an algal bloom and ended up rolling on the floor of the ER
items.description: The government knew a harmful toxin had been found in its algal bloom, but took months to update its health advice.

items.title: A third of all Victorian car thefts now involve key cloning devices
items.description: Police say criminals are able to steal certain push-button start models within 15 seconds, using key reprogramming devices bought online.

items.title: Mother was 'living beyond her means' during fake cancer scam, court hears
items.description: An Adelaide mother who faked her six-year-old son's cancer diagnosis to deceitfully raise money was "living the life of the rich and famous" despite serious financial struggles, a court has heard.

items.title: The killing of a Nepali security guard reveals the hidden toll of the Iran war
items.description: The killing of a Nepali security guard in Abu Dhabi highlights the growing risks faced by millions of migrant workers across the Gulf as the conflict between Iran, Israel and the United States escalates.

items.title: 'A confronting case': Woman pleads guilty to 21 animal cruelty charges
items.description: A Tasmanian woman has pleaded guilty to 21 animal cruelty charges. More than 70 animals were found living in "squalid" conditions, with some requiring euthanasing.

items.title: Police charge author Craig Silvey with more child exploitation offences
items.description: Popular Australian author Craig Silvey is charged with two more child exploitation offences, including allegedly producing child exploitation material.

items.title: Danish royals honour fallen, meet the public at Australian War Memorial
items.description: A crowd of people waving Danish flags waited outside the Australian War Memorial for a chance to meet King Frederick and Queen Mary on day three of their royal tour.

items.title: 'High chance' of Qld cyclone forming this week after more rain
items.description: A tropical low sitting south of the Solomon Islands now has a "high chance" of becoming a cyclone as it heads towards the Queensland coast.

items.title: These musicians stole our hearts on The Piano. Where are they now?
items.description: In the first season of The Piano, nobody quite knew what to expect. But what happens after you get the chance to play for a national audience? We catch up with some of the pianists to find out how music continues to shape their lives.

items.title: What is 'lifestyle creep' — and how can you avoid it?
items.description: If you tend to splurge on more indulgences any time you receive a pay rise, you may be suffering from lifestyle creep — and it could have a longstanding effect on your finances.

items.title: This week in history quiz: COVID cruise ships, Neighbours launches and walking in space
items.description: This week in years past saw the first ever spacewalk, the Harbour Bridge opening and more importantly the premiere of Neighbours. Test your memory.

items.title: How this Sydney high school drastically improved its HSC results
items.description: The Department of Education has released the HSC most improved list, which detailed the schools showing the most growth in the numbers of students receiving the top three bands in the HSC.

items.title: Live: ASX steady as war rattles global stocks, RBA rate hike looms
items.description: Global investors continue to rotate out of shares as the Iranian conflict continues and rising oil prices stoke inflation fears, but locally the ASX is only marginally lower. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: 'The country is watching': Bernardi says One Nation must win seats in SA poll
items.description: Federal MP Barnaby Joyce is predicting a big primary vote for One Nation at this Saturday's South Australian election, but lead candidate Cory Bernardi would not be drawn on how many lower house seats he hoped the party would win.

items.title: Video captures moment hot air balloon knocks kayakers into Canberra lake
items.description: Two kayakers were busy snapping selfies when they noticed one of the hot air balloons coming towards them on Canberra's Lake Burley Griffin.

items.title: Victorian government to pay $125m to settle COVID class action
items.description: The state government has agreed to a $125 million settlement, which has to be approved by the Supreme Court.

items.title: Qld minister approved theatre name months before public consultation
items.description: Documents released under right to information show Queensland's arts minister was "set" on the name in January, months before the community was invited to have their say.

items.title: Inside the experiences of Roblox for parents and children
items.description: The ABC has spoken to more than half a dozen parents about their children's experience on Roblox following the Commonwealth's calls for a meeting with the platform amid reports of grooming and exposure to explicit content.

items.title: Final heartbreak for Aussies in US sevens decider
items.description: The Black Ferns score three late tries to steal a dramatic 22-21 win over Australia to take out the World Rugby Sevens Series event in New Jersey.
